requirements.definition: A shall be integer or real, and B shall have the same type as A.

requirements.title: SIGN nonzero and integer-zero result values
requirements.definition: For B greater than zero SIGN returns |A|; for B less than zero SIGN returns -|A|; for integer B equal to zero SIGN returns |A|.

pending.SIGN-positive-B-magnitude: Use SIGN(-7,2) and SIGN(-3.0,2.0) with sentinels and assert exact results 7 and 3.0; mutate B sign.
pending.SIGN-negative-B-negative-magnitude: Use SIGN(7,-2) and SIGN(3.0,-2.0) with sentinels and assert exact results -7 and -3.0; mutate B sign.
pending.SIGN-integer-zero-B-magnitude: Use SIGN(-7,0) with a nonzero-B companion and assert exact result 7; mutate B to -1.
pending.SIGN-negative-A-magnitude-copy: Use positive and negative A operands with the same positive B and assert both results carry positive magnitude; mutate A values to equal magnitudes only after the sign copy is checked.
